claim_scores.rationale: Uses one `dspy.Predict` plus `dspy.JSONAdapter` flow across three LM variants and inspects all three outcomes: schema class, `{"type": "json_object"}`, and no `response_format`.
Shows `supported_params` gating by omitting `response_format` when the LM does not advertise it and asserting that absence on the plain LM call.
Includes an LM with `supported_params={'response_format'}` but `supports_response_schema=False` and asserts DSPy sends `{"type": "json_object"}`.
Includes an LM with both capabilities enabled and asserts `response_format` is a generated `pydantic.BaseModel` subclass.
Uses a simple `answer: str` output signature, avoiding open-ended mappings and `ToolCalls`, so the comparison isolates LM capability flags.
